Commentary.Commentary: The Indian players are already seen warming up. The urgency is evident and they are already doing catching practice. Remember, they were poor in the field in the second innings. The intent is there to improve themselves.

Harsha Bhogle on-air reckons India will have 105-110 overs in hand to bowl the visitors out taking the bad light into account. The home side are favourites to win this game but stranger things have happened in cricket. Can the tourists bat out of their skins and save this game?

The Sri Lankan bowlers tried hard but without much positive results. Each of the bowlers took a wicket each but also conceded runs on a regular basis. With still more than 3 and a half sessions to play out and a mammoth target of 410, it will be a stern test for their batsmen.

A good batting performance from India has brought them into a position from where it is very unlikely that they will lose this game. Apart from Vijay and Rahane, everyone else chipped in with runs. Pujara missed out on his fifty by a mere run but Kohli and Rohit succeeded in scoring theirs.
9th Test fifty for Rohit Sharma! Full delivery outside off, driven crisply to sweeper cover for a brace. That's it. INDIA DECLARE ON 246/5.

Not Out! Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma slaps it to sweeper cover. He runs the first one quickly and goes for the second. The throw is collected by the keeper who whips off the bails. It is referred upstairs. The replays show the batsman is safe.
A run out appeal against Rohit Sharma has been taken upstairs. Seems to be safe.
Hangs back to this one and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shorter in length, punched off the back foot to long off for a single.
Jadeja eases this to sweeper cover and crosses over for an easy run.
Taps this one through covers for a single.
It has gone a bit dark. Bad light might come into play early today. Moreover, after India declare, the spin twins will probably do the majority of the bowling.
Prods forward to this one and turns it through mid-wicket for a single. India lead by 400 now. Still, the declaration hasn't come.
Places this one with the angle behind point for a single.
Driven through the mid off region. One run added to the total.
RAVINDRA JADEJA walks out to bat. He will be flashing his blade in order to score quick runs.

OUT! Kohli holes out! The way he was playing, it was evident that he was just trying to score off every ball. Length delivery outside off, Kohli attempts to slog it down the ground but drags it off the inner half of the bat towards wide long on. Suranga Lakmal runs to his right and takes a safe catch. A good knock from the Indian skipper ends. India's lead is three short of 400.
Pin point yorker on off, Virat is alert to it and jams it out nicely.
Slower delivery, Rohit reads it well and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Leg bye! Kohli uses his feet and Gamage spots that. Bowls it on middle and leg. The Indian skipper tries to flick it but misses. Sneaks in a leg bye.
LAHIRU GAMAGE to have a bowl now.
15th Test fifty for Virat Kohli in Test cricket! Fullish delivery, Kohli whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run. No emotions from him and he carries on.
On a length well outside off, cut away through covers for a single.
Drifting down the leg stump, Rohit goes for the sweep but misses.
Well played! Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire
On middle, flicked behind square on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! This is special! Dug in short, Sharma pulls it off his front foot and nails the pull behind square on the leg side for a boundary. 12 from the over.
Kohli drills this one to long on for a single. He looks for the second run but the fielder is quick to attack the ball.
FOUR! Hit hard! Back of a length well outside off, Kohli slaps it through point for a rocketing boundary.
Shortish delivery, pulled straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball around off, Sharma punches it towards extra cover. Lakmal himself runs after it but fails to pick it properly. A run taken.
Wide! Hurls this one wide outside off, Sharma has nothing to do with it.
Kohli uses his feet to this one and flat-bats it to long off for a single.

Vijay Shankar again comes in with a drink. He has a discussion with Kohli and Sharma. The skipper has a look towards the dressing room. The way these two are playing, the declaration will be around the corner.

A slight confusion but all's well. Rohit pushes it towards covers and comes halfway down the track for a run. Kohli spots the bowler quickly get to the ball and sends him back. However, the man from covers does the mopping work and fires the throw to the keeper. Meanwhile, Sharma slips as he tries to turn but gathers himself well and makes it in time.
Kohli flicks it through square leg for one.
Sharma plays it round the corner for a single.
Kohli milks this down to long on for a run.
Punched through covers for a brace.
Sharma taps it towards point and crosses over for a run.
Vijay Shankar comes out with drinks. The talk will be about when to declare.
Another bouncer, Kohli ducks under it.
Short ball, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
On a length, pushed to mid off.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Oh ho! What a spectacular effort! Technically a drop but if he had taken that, it would been an amazing catch. Shows what commitment means to this young man. Short delivery on middle, Sharma pulls it in front of square leg. Samarawickrama lines it up, moves to his left and dives like a goalkeeper. Gets his outstretched hand to it but fails to hold on. A run taken. Even Kohli is seen applauding that effort.
Fuller in length outside off, eased off the front foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Rohit tucks this one towards short mid-wicket where Dhananjaya dives to his left to make a great stop.

In the air... but safe! A rare false shot from Rohit Sharma. Loopy delivery on leg stump, Sharma kneels and goes for the big sweep but ends up top edging it. The ball lobs towards Mathews at short fine leg. The ex-skipper runs in but only manages to take it on the bounce. He was standing quite deep. If he was closer, it could have been an easy catch for him.
Sharma takes a couple of steps down the track and blocks it eventually.
Quick and short wide outside off, Sharma places it straight to the man at backward point.
Strides forward to the fullish delivery and milks it down to long on for a single.
Spinning into Kohli who drives it back to the bowler.
Very full on middle and leg, jammed out around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Top class! On a length in line of the stumps, Kohli backs away a bit, comes down the track and lifts it over wide mid off for a one-bounce boundary.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Rohit flays it to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Fractionally overpitched on middle, flicked with ease to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Similar length ball on off, Sharma hangs back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Good length delivery, tailing in. Kohli flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Slow through the air outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Shorter in length, Sharma hangs back and punches it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Turns this one with the spin to backward square leg for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between Sharma and Kohli. It has come at a run-a-ball.
Drifting towards the leg stump, swept to fine leg to rotate strike.
A bit short around off, stays low. Punched off the back foot to extra cover.
We are back for the final session. VIRAT KOHLI and ROHIT SHARMA to continue batting. LAKSHAN SANDAKAN will continue his spell. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 3 ...

Dhawan who was playing a bit slowly flourished afterwards. He hit a flurry of boundaries and made a fluent fifty before perishing to Sandakan. Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma have continued to play free-flowing cricket, keeping the scoreboard ticking. Seems that the score is already good enough against a team which is low on morale. The track is taking substantial turn as well and some deliveries are keeping low. When will the declaration come? Let's find out in a while.

Session highlights - 26 overs, 141 runs and 2 wickets. India have swelled the lead to 355 runs and are in total command of the proceedings. They have taken the attack to the opposition, putting them under more pressure. Pujara changed his tempo according to the situation of the game and scored a breezy 49.
On a flatter trajectory on leg stump, Kohli turns it around the corner for a single. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 4!
Sliding in with the arm, Kohli tries to play it across but wears in on his pads.
Quick and flat on off, punched off the back foot to silly mid off.
Played with the spin to mid-wicket.
Dhananjaya is flying around in the field today. Coming in with the arm, Kohli clips it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives full length to his right to stop it.
Kohli uses his feet to this one and blocks it.
Kohli takes his helmet off and is putting his cap on.
Hangs back and punches this one to long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Two runs added to the total.

Ooh.. that stayed really low! Worrying signs for Sri Lanka. Batting last on this track won't be easy at all. Shortish ball outside off, doesn't rise at all. Kohli adjusts well and punches it to covers.
Well bowled! Sandakan slips in the googly around off. Sharma tries to drive it but gets an outside edge past Mathews at slip. He hares after it and saves a run for his side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Sandakan was looking to bowl Sharma from out from behind the legs but the batsman is up to the task. Crouches and sweeps it hard past the keeper to pick up another boundary.
Angling in to Sharma who nudges it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! He is so good with his front foot pull shots. Shortish delivery, Sharma rises with the bounce and nails it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Around the hips, clipped past square leg for a single.
Uses his feet to this one but is not quite to the pitch of it. Does well to block it in the end.
Full length delivery, tailing in. Sharma tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery around off, Kohli uses his feet and whips it to deep square leg for a run.
Milked to long on for a run and Kohli will retain strike.
Coming in with the arm, Kohli tucks it nicely through fine leg for a couple.
Sharma milks a single down to long on for a run.
Camps back to the flatter delivery and blocks it.
Waits for this one and tucks it through square leg for a run.
Strides forward and drives it through mid on for a run.
Angling in to Sharma, he turns it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
No ball! Full on middle and leg, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single. Gamage has overstepped as well.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Effortless! Length delivery outside off, Sharma leans into it and caresses it through covers for a glorious boundary.
That was too close to cut and he almost chopped it back! Back of a length delivery close to the off stump, Sharma looks to manufacture a cut behind point but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fractionally overpitched on middle and leg, Kohli flicks it nonchalantly in front of square leg for a single.
Turning in sharply from around off, Sharma stays back and defends it tentatively.
Leg stumpish line again, whipped through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting towards the pads, swept hard to fine leg for a brace.
Hangs back to the shortish delivery and punches it through cover-point to rotate strike.
Spinning into Rohit who defends it to short leg.
Shortish delivery away outside off, cut away behind point for a single. 10 from the over.
FOUR! Trademark Kohli! Fullish delivery around off, Kohli walks down the track and whips it using his strong bottom hand. Gets it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Similar length delivery, Kohli puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length outside off, played with an open bat face to point.
FOUR! Streaky runs! They count no matter how they come. Back of a length delivery around off, Sharma goes for a half-hearted pull but gets a top edge over first slip and the ball races to the fence.
Quicker and flatter, blocked watchfully.
Spinning into Sharma who tucks it around the corner for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stays back and punches it to mid off.
ROHIT SHARMA strides out to bat.

OUT! Dhawan departs in a bid to up the ante! It has been a good knock from him nevertheless. Sandakan floats it nicely around middle and leg. The southpaw senses an opportunity to score runs and skips down the track. After pitching, the ball turns away substantially which is good enough to beat the outside edge of Dhawan's bat who was attempting a wild slog across the line. Dickwella collects it nicely and whips the bails off in a flash. Something to rejoice for the Sri Lankans. The hosts are ahead by 307 runs.
Waits for this one and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Kohli whips this with the spin through mid-wicket for a run and will retain strike.
Coming in with the arm, punched to long on for a run.
Clears his front leg and flicks it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Drifting down the leg side, Dhawan paddle sweeps it through fine leg to find the fence. He is in ODI mode at the moment.

FOUR! Brilliant! Dhawan skips down the track and Dhananjaya shortens his length. The southpaw is beaten in the flight as well but he is in such a zone that his timing is spot on. He punches it through extra cover for a rocketing boundary.
Floated delivery, driven through covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! That's the shot of man in prime form! Tossed up outside off, Dhawan skips down the track and tonks it down the ground. It has come right off the screws and flies over the sightscreen. That brings up 2000 Test runs for Dhawan as well.
Leans into the stroke and milks it down to long on for a run.
6th Test fifty for Shikhar Dhawan! Waits for the ball to come to him and punches it to wide long on to get to the other end. He has a grin on his face and the crowd acknowledges his knock.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly.
The batsmen take their helmets off as it is going to be spin from both ends. LAKSHAN SANDAKAN to roll his arm over for the first time in this innings.
Hits this one hard through wide mid on for a run and moves to 49.
Clears his front leg to the fullish delivery and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Similar delivery, similar shot, same result.
On leg stump, tucked to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Floated on off, Kohli tries to clip it but gets a leading edge to mid off. A run taken.
FOUR! Dhawan is almost going after every ball now. Short and width on offer, Dhawan rises on his toes and cracks it over point to find the ropes.
On middle and leg, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower in pace and on a shorter length wide outside off, Dhawan goes for the cut but is beaten by the lack of pace.
FOUR! Shot! Fullish delivery around off, Dhawan comes forward and drills it through mid off for another boundary.
Back of a length delivery, Dhawan punches it hard towards Dhananjaya at short point where he dives to his left to make a great stop.

On a length outside off, Dhawan uses his feet and smacks it towards cover. The fielder does well to get a hand to it as the ball parries behind. A couple is taken but Dhawan wants the third. The skipper rightly sends him back.

Time for Virat Kohli to make his way to the middle. He is being cheered by his home crowd. The skipper is going through a purple patch at the moment. Knowing the way he goes about with his game, he will be eager to take the attack to the opposition. The declaration will also be on his mind.

OUT! A breezy knock from Pujara comes to an end! Brilliant take from Mathews to leave Pujara one short of a half century. Tossed up delivery around off, Pujara strides forward to play for the turn but it is not present. Ends up getting a thick outside edge that flies towards Mathews at first slip. He is sharp as a hawk, bends low to his left and takes a gem of a catch. First wicket for Dhananjaya de Silva in this match. India are effectively 269/3.
Uses his feet to this one and turns it to square leg.
Slow through the air on leg stump, Pujara works it to fine leg for a brace.
Clips this one with the spin to mid-wicket.

Nimble on his feet again. The urgency from Pujara is visible. He clips it through square leg and straightaway calls for a couple. Till the fielder moves to his right, collects it and throws it back, two runs have been taken.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pujara lunges forward in defense.

Drinks are on the field now. Although it has been a wicketless hour, the hosts aren't looking to score runs quickly. A run rate of 3.40 doesn't show India as a team that is in a hurry to set a target for the opposition. Chandimal is rotating his bowlers in search of a wicket but is unsuccessful so far. The lead for the home side is 265 as of now. What does the upcoming hour hold for us?
Ends the over by hitting the ball straight to the man at mid off.
Lakmal tries to go for the yorker and slips a low full toss around middle and leg. Dhawan clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Dhawan stays in the crease and defends it with a straight bat.
100 up for India! Pujara hits it through covers to rotate strike and take India to a century. The lead moves up to 263 runs.

As the talks about the range of target for Sri Lanka are on, the scorecard of the lone Sri Lanka - Zimbabwe Test played earlier this year flashes on screen. In that game, the Asian side chased down a target of 387 in the fourth innings to win the game. It will be interesting to remember, though, that they were run close by their lesser-fancied opponents. At the same time, currently, their batting doesn't seem to be in the same flow as in that game.
Length ball outside off, punched towards cover-point.
Fuller ball outside off, played defensively towards point.
Dhawan hangs in his crease and safely negotiates the last ball of the over.
Around middle and leg, flicked away through backward square leg for one.
Dhawan goes on the back foot and punches it to the man stationed at the mid-wicket boundary for one run.
Pujara places it through covers and takes a run.
Dhananjaya loops it up around middle, Dhawan comes down to hit it to long on for one.
Served around middle and leg, flicked round the corner for a single.
Change in bowling. DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is brought back for another over.
Dhawan pushes it to the cover region once again.
Fuller outside off, driven crisply to the cover fielder.

The commentators on air discuss about India's tactics here. They are unable to understand what the thinking might be in the Indian camp as the run rate is hovering around the 3-run mark. They observe that the Indians were more aggressive in the first innings than now, when they have a lead and have to set a target for the Lankans. It is observed that once the ball gets a bit older, the purchase off the surface reduces. Hence India need to give their bowlers ample time to pick up the opposition's wickets, they opine.
This ball is flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pujara punches this to the man at covers.
Similar delivery around off, Pujara stays in the crease and pushes it towards cover-point.
Length ball around off, punched towards covers.
Good work, Chandimal! Dhawan comes down and plays the cover drive, the fielder there dives to prevent a run.
Pujara works it away off his pads for a single.
Tapped towards covers for a single.

FOUR! The ball came to Sandakan before noon and he dived after noon! Flatter outside off, Dhawan goes back and cuts it towards backward point. A misfield there makes the ball go to the fence. Dhawan gets to 8000 first-class runs with this.
As seen throughout this innings, Pujara has shown positive intent by using his feet against the spinner. Does so yet again as he flicks it to the man at deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter around off, Dhawan goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Pujara stays put in the crease and blocks it stoutly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
Lakmal bowls it outside off, Dhawan charges down and looks to attack the bowler but misses. The ball bounces just in front of the keeper and he fails to make a clean stop. Concedes a bye.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off.
Around off, the batter blocks it from the crease.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back into the attack. De Silva bowled a solitary over, maybe just to change ends of Perera.
Pujara looks to cut but misses the ball.
Dhawan gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pujara comes down and whips it through mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! Nigel Llong has got this spot on! Dhananjaya from round the wicket floats it around off. Pujara lunges forward in defense but gets hit on the front pad. His bat is also very close to the pad. The visitors appeal but the umpire shakes his head in negation. The close-in fielders egg their skipper to review this and he takes it upstairs. There was always a doubt that Pujara's bat could have hit it. But no! There wasn't much spin on that ball and hence although the impact was umpire's call, the ball would have gone on to miss the sticks. Excellent decision by the on-field umpire this. Sri Lanka lose a review as Pujara survives.
'Aaaah' shout the Lankans for an LBW decision against Pujara. The umpire doesn't agree and the visitors opt for the DRS.
Dhawan punches this off the back foot through covers for one.
Change of ends for DILRUWAN PERERA.
Finds the mid on fielder with this push.
Pujara gets on the back foot and punches it towards covers.
Around off and middle, Shikhar flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Dhawan lunges forward to keep it out watchfully.
Pujara now turns it through mid-wicket and jogs to the other end.
Deep cover in place.

FOUR! Welcome to the attack, says Pujara with a boundary. The bowler has been given a 6-3 leg side field and Cheteshwar says he'll counter that to score runs. De Silva comes round the wicket and floats it around off. The right-handed batsman charges down and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA to bowl his off-breaks now. He looked good with the ball in the first innings although he was wicketless.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for a single.
Pujara hits it towards covers.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Shikhar drives it through wide mid off. Chandimal runs towards it, puts in the dive and restricts the batter to just one. Gamage has crossed the line and hence it is a no ball.
Another harmless delivery outside off, Dhawan just lets it be.
This is landed outside off, Shikhar covers his stumps and lets that go.
Fuller outside off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Suranga Lakmal is seen sitting out of the playing field. The struggle is a bit too much for the bowler, who is the most experienced of the visiting bowlers.
'Two, two, two...' shouts Pujara as soon as he clips it towards fine leg. Shows the intensity in the running and gets the brace with ease.
Pujara lunges forward in defense.
Pushed towards point from the crease.
Cheteshwar gets down the track and whips it towards deep square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Shot! If you want to show someone how to use his/her feet to the ball, this is the one. Perera floats it around off, Pujara slinks down and drives it straight down the ground. The mid off fielder tries to stop it but fails to do so. A boundary results.
I think Dhawan read that previous insert somehow. He charges down the track to hit it past covers. Gets just one though.
Pujara pushes it to mid off.
This ball is outside off, shouldered arms to by CP. It's a no ball as Gamage has overstepped.

Interestingly, Pujara is batting on 23 off 28 balls while Dhawan is on 20 off 48. A sort of role reversals it seems. Generally the southpaw is known to tee off while the right-hander is known to graft it out in the beginning. Seems to be a case of the batsmen playing according to their form and the game time that they've had.
A straight bat face shown in defending this ball around off.
Pujara stays in the crease and stonewalls it.
Another full delivery outside off, Pujara extends the bat as he drives it towards mid off.
Similar delivery outside off, left alone by Che.
Fuller length ball outside off, Pujara presents a straight defensive bat.
Pujara turns it through mid-wicket and rotates strike.
This time Dhawan drives it through covers and picks up a single.
This is bowled around off, Dhawan defends it solidly.
Dhawan defensively pushes it towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served around off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Around off, defended from the crease.
On a length outside off, Pujara defends it and looks to take a start for a run. As he does so, the ball hits his bat and he ends up pushing it to the man at covers.
This is outside off, left alone by Pujara.

FOUR! Ahhh! Not acceptable that from Karunaratne. Fuller outside off, Pujara drives it nicely towards covers. The fielder gets to his left but dives over the ball instead of stopping that. It trickles away to the fence.
Gamage begins from round the wicket and bangs it on a shorter length. Dhawan pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket. Gets only a run as the fielder in the deep does well to not concede another.
LAHIRU GAMAGE will run in from the other end. With Lakmal not looking at his best in the first session, it is imperative for this pacer to hold his own.
Dhawan eases this down to long on for a single to retain strike.
Blocked off the front foot onto the ground.

Flatter outside off served on a shorter length, Dhawan stays deep in the crease and plays the square cut. The fielder at backward point dives to his right but just manages to parry it towards third man. The batsmen, meanwhile cross over for a single. Seeing the fielder being a bit slow to get to the ball, a late decision is taken to go for the second and it is completed with ease.
Floated around off, Dhawan lunges forward in defense.
This time Pujara gets it past the bat-pad for a single.
Starts from round the wicket and bowls it flatter on the pads. Pujara clips it towards short leg.

The men who matter make their way out to the middle after having what should have been a sumptuous meal. SHIKHAR DHAWAN is seen walking with his left arm around Dickwella's neck. A talk about Delhi weather? Or the menu for the dinner, perhaps? Maybe the plans about the Indian batter's birthday party? CHETESHWAR PUJARA also walks in to the middle, batting at more than run a ball at the moment. DILRUWAN PERERA to kick off the session.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

The Sri Lankans will be aiming to trigger a collapse after the lunch interval. Things won't be easy for them though as India have capable batsmen waiting in the wings. Lakmal threw up once again but thankfully for the visitors, he is fine and is back on the field. The tourists in general continue to struggle to cope up with the hazy conditions. Let's see if they can adjust well this time. The ploy from the hosts will be to keep batting with a positive mindset and take the visitors out of the game. Join us in a while for the second session.

After bowling out Sri Lanka early in the morning, India have tried to force the initiative but not with much success. Rahane was promoted up the order but couldn't capitalize on the opportunity. He survived a couple of DRS calls and never looked settled in the middle. Eventually, he holed out attempting a big shot. He has been dismal in this series which is a rarity. Still, the hosts are in the driver's seat with a healthy lead of 214 in their kitty.
Shorter in length around off, tucked past mid-wicket for a single. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!

That's nasty! Shortish delivery around off, Pujara gets into an awkward position and tries to keep it out but gets hit on the glove. The ball then deflects onto his stomach. Good pace and bounce from Lakmal.
Served on a fuller length, Pujara tries to flick it but the ball takes the leading edge and goes through covers. A couple taken.

Pujara clearly showing his intent here. This ball is bowled at a fuller length. Pujara tries to play it over covers but the ball takes a thick outside edge and goes towards Karunaratne at deep point who is late to react before throwing it back. The batsmen pick up a brace.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
A man from square leg is moved to covers.
Lakmal bowls this on a fuller length, Dhawan flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Shortish delivery outside off, Pujara sits back and punches it through covers to find the ropes again.

FOUR! Well played! Floated delivery on off, Pujara shimmies down the track and drives it elegantly past the bowler. The fielder at mid off had no chance of cutting that off and a boundary it is. With that, Pujara becomes the leading run-scorer in Tests in 2017 going past Dean Elgar. His prolific form continues.
Darted in, tucked towards short fine leg for a quick single. There is a wayward throw at the keeper's end but it doesn't result in any extra run. India lead by 200 now.
Not convincing but he will take it. Loopy delivery around off, Dhawan uses his feet and looks to drive it on the up but is not in control. Gets it through cover-point and comes back for the second.
That was a peach of a delivery! Quicker through the air on off, Pujara is squared up in his stance and gets it off the outer half past point. A run taken.
Tossed up delivery, Dhawan uses his feet and knocks it down to long off for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Served on a good length and the ball nips back in to Pujara. He tries to defend it but misses.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. Good athleticism shown by the fielder. They manage to come back for the second.
Length ball in line of the stumps this time, Pujara shows him a straight bat in defense.
Good length ball outside off, Che doesn't flirt with it.
On a good length outside off, Pujara doesn't play at it and lets it go.
Slow through the air, blocked watchfully.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Cheteshwar Pujara walks in.

OUT! Rahane's poor patch continues! He has looked out of sorts throughout the series and his worries only seem to increase. Loopy delivery outside off, Rahane uses his feet and looks to go over long on but the bat turns in his hands. Ends up miscuing it towards Lakshan Sandakan in the same region. He bends a bit and pouches it safely. Good passage of play for the Sri Lankans. The hosts are ahead by 192 runs.
Spinning into Rahane who strides forward to block it.
Shorter in length, worked around the corner for a single.
Strides forward and clips it with the spin to mid-wicket.

Rahane has been struggling a lot in this series. His feet are not moving the way they should and as a result, he is playing false strokes. He is not judging the lengths properly and that is why he is reacting late as well. An important overseas tour of South Africa is coming up. Rahane needs to work on his technique as he is really a vital cog in the wheel for the Indians. His average away from home is really impressive too. He needs a few good knocks under his belt before heading to South Africa.
Driven towards the mid off region.
On a length outside off, played with an open bat face to point.
Fullish delivery, knocked to mid off.
Fullish delivery, eased off the front foot to covers.
Shortish delivery outside off, staying low. Rahane is surprised by the lack of bounce and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Uses his feet and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quick and flat outside off, Rahane shuffles across, covers his stumps and makes an assured leave.
Slower through the air, Dhawan shimmies down the track and knocks it down to long off for a run.
Shorter in length, punched off the back foot to covers.
Coming in with the arm, Dhawan tries to tuck it but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Loopy delivery on off, Dhawan lunges forward in defense.
DILRUWAN PERERA gets a change of ends.
Back of a length ball, Rahane cuts it to point.
Short ball around off, Dhawan plays it square off the wicket for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
In the zone at a shorter length outside off, Dhawan goes hard at it but misses the ball.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan tries to defend it but gets a bottom edge to it. The ball dies down into the ground.
Bowled outside off, Dhawan leaves it alone.
SURANGA LAKMAL is ambling back to the field with a mask on. Immediately removes his mask, hands it to the umpire and gets ready to bowl.
Tossed up delivery, eased off the front foot to mid off.
Loose shot! Shortish delivery and room on offer, Rahane goes for a slash but fails to make any contact.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Bouncer outside off, Rahane lets it go with ease.
Similar delivery and width on offer, chopped behind point for a single.
Lakmal is seen sitting on the sidelines. Sri Lanka will want him to be fit soon and take the field.
Back of a length outside off, played with an angled bat towards cover-point.

Drinks have been taken. India have lost a wicket early in their innings but have come out with a positive intent. Their batsmen are playing shots to deliveries that they would leave on another day. Rahane, who has been sent up the order is battling on after surviving two close LBW calls.The Sri Lankan bowling has not been too bad. However, their players continue to struggle in the environmental conditions. We saw Lakmal walking out of the field due to the same. Hope he is alright.

Not Out! Rahane is saved yet again. Sri Lanka do not lose a review though as it was umpire's call. On a flatter trajectory around off, spinning in. Rahane goes deep in the crease to work it across but misses to get pinged on the back pad. The visitors appeal loudly but umpire Nigel Llong stays put. Perera is not that confident and he walks towards Dickwella. The keeper feels it will be touch and go and tells his skipper to take the review. Chandimal challenges the decision. Time for the replays. There is no inside edge. The Hawk Eye rolls in. It shows that the ball is just clipping the leg stump and hence, the on-field call stays. It was much closer than it seemed to be in real time.

Review time for Sri Lanka! Chandimal decides to review an LBW decision after a chat with the bowler and the keeper. Ajinkya Rahane is the man in question. Seems close to the naked eye but might be sliding down leg.
Quicker one on middle, kept out watchfully.
Comes forward and defends it with the turn to short leg.

FOUR! Great shot! A touch short outside off, spinning in. Rahane rocks back and cuts it against the spin through covers to find the fence. Never easy to play such shots against spin but he executed that to perfection.
Rahane uses his feet and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Makes good use of the depth of the crease and turns it past short leg for a run.
Bowled at a fuller length, Rahane drives it to cover.
Fuller length this time, Rahane drives it to mid on for nothing.
Short again, Rahane tries to pull it but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Back of a length, Dhawan pulls it to mid-wicket for nothing.
Good length ball around off, Dhawan does not fiddle with it.

Shorter in length this time, spinning in. Rahane hangs back and clips it besides the pitch on the leg side. Dhananjaya de Silva who is wearing a mask runs to his left, dives full length and makes a brilliant save.
Loopy delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! That shot will ease his nerves! Tossed up delivery outside off, Rahane dances down the track and lifts it over mid off and picks up a boundary to his name.
Dhawan is nimble on his feet and knocks it down to long off to rotate strike.
Hangs back to this one and defends it solidly.

A stifled appeal for a bat-pad denied! Quicker delivery, sliding in. Dhawan tries to defend it but misses. The ball hits his pad and carries to the short leg fielder. Casual query from Sri Lanka to which the umpire pays no heed. There was no bat involved.
DILRUWAN PERERA comes into the attack.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.

Lakmal is struggling. This is the second time Lakmal is throwing up on the field. He hasn't been able to cope up with the hazy conditions. The physio is taking him off the field. Hope he is alright. Dasun Shanaka is the substitute fielder.
This is a shot which is played in ODI cricket. Full length delivery on middle and leg, Dhawan whips it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Shikhar plants his front foot across and lets it safely through.
Fullish delivery slanting across the southpaw, he puts in a confident stride forward and eases it to cover-point.
Fuller in length outside off, Shikhar makes another leave.
Length delivery outside off, not much nibble in the air. Dhawan leaves it alone and lets it sail into the gloves of the keeper.
Outside off, left alone from Rahane.
Served around off, Rahane plays it to point for nothing.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

NOT OUT! Rahane will be relieved! He has been in bad form in the recent matches and this dismissal would have added to his misery but it is not to be. Good length ball outside off, tailing back in to Rahane. He tries to flick it but misses it completely. The ball goes on to hit his front pad and the Sri Lankan players go up in unison. The umpire gives it out. Rahane has a chat with his partner and decides to take the review. Hawk Eye shows that the ball would go on to miss the leg stump. Kohli from the dressing room is delighted and appreciates the review.
Rahane has been given out LBW. He has a chat with his partner and goes for the review. Seems to be missing leg at the first go.
Back of a length ball, Rahane hangs back and defends it to mid-wicket.
Similar delivery outside off, Dhawan remains circumspect in approach and defends it solidly.
Fullish in length outside off, Shikhar plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Short of a length outside off, Dhawan doesn't fiddle with it.
Length delivery outside off, Dhawan lifts his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery on off, Dhawan hangs back and defends it in a compact manner.
Slips this one down the leg side, Dhawan tries to clip it away but misses.
Length delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot to backward point.
Fullish delivery outside off, left alone.
Back of a length outside off, chopped past point for a single.
Rahane is off the mark! Good length delivery on the hips, Rahane tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Well outside off, Rahane lets it go.

Ajinkya Rahane has been promoted up the order. Wise decision from the skipper. Rahane has been struggling with his form and it is a good opportunity for him to get among the runs with India holding the edge at the moment.

OUT! Lakmal strikes! Vijay was taking his chances and has sacrificed his wicket. Perhaps, the suggestion from the dressing room might have been to play attacking cricket. On a length around off, swinging away. Vijay doesn't move his feet much and goes for a loose drive. Ends up getting a faint edge behind and Dickwella moves to his right to take a regulation catch. The Sri Lankans appeal and up goes the umpire's finger. India lead by 173.
Back of a length around off, pushed wide of mid on for a run.
This delivery stays low again. Fullish outside off, Vijay lets it go.
Intentions are clear from Vijay. He is not going to hold back. Back of a length delivery, nipping in substantially. Vijay looks to smash it through the line but misses.
Length delivery outside off, Vijay stays back and defends it with authority.
Fullish delivery outside off, stays low. Vijay plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Back of a length delivery slanting across Dhawan. He stands tall and cuts it behind point for a single.
LAHIRU GAMAGE to steam in from the other end. Two slips and a gully in place.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Vijay prods forward in defense. 8 runs from the first over and India are off to a good start.
A deep point in place now as second slip has moved out.

FOUR! Certainly a change in approach from Vijay. With a healthy lead in the kitty, he is playing shots off deliveries which he normally leaves. Good length delivery well outside off, Vijay pushes at it with hard hands and gets a thick edge. Beats gully and the ball runs away to the fence.
FOUR! Smashed! Shortish in length, a bit of room as well. Vijay camps back and slaps it with authority through covers to find the fence. India are away.
Well bowled! On a length in the zone of apprehension, moving away after pitching. Vijay feels for it and gets beaten.
A lot of Sri Lankan players take the field with their masks on. Not surprising as they have done so earlier in the game as well.
Short of a length outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Vijay points his bat skywards to allow it through.
